The method in the class
recommendAttackingMonster(Monster defender) Arena
recommends the best monster in the array to use in a battle based on its
monster

them will be selected.
(c) Construct the method . You can
recommendAttackingMonster(Monster defender)
assume that there is at least one monster in the monsters array, that the attacking
monster is not in the monsters array, and that the method
getAttackingWeight
is available. [6]
